question: What's the difference between the standard Customer Ticket Intake and Categorization process and the emergency/expedited version?
short_answer: The standard path (SOP-SUPPORT-001) goes through Support Team Lead via MK-SupportDesk in the normal order. The expedited path (SOP-SUPPORT-001-EDGE-B) is only for genuine emergenci
detailed_answer: The standard path (SOP-SUPPORT-001) goes through Support Team Lead via MK-SupportDesk in the normal order. The expedited path (SOP-SUPPORT-001-EDGE-B) is only for genuine emergencies: it requires verbal pre-approval first, immediate action, then retroactive formal filing within 24 hours — and repeated use of the expedited path for the same request type triggers a review.
escalation_path: Support Associate -> Support Team Lead -> Support Manager -> Customer Experience Director
